METRIC_WARNINGS: THREE DIFFERENT CUSTOMER COUNTS EXIST — do not mix them. (1) Repeat Purchase Behavior report: 5,285 unique customers Q2. (2) Demographics report population: 20,410 customers / 24,800 ordered units Q2. (3) Customer Loyalty Analytics: 13,284 current customers wk ending Jul 25. The Agency Handbook warns explicitly against treating these as one number. brand_health.total_customers uses 20,410 to stay consistent with the prior file and the demographic percentages; repeat_purchase_rate_pct is derived from the 5,285 population and is reported on its own basis.

brand_search_share_pct computed per Amazon's Branded Search Ratio definition = brand search / awareness = 237 / 117,993 = 0.20% for Q2 (Week 30: 32 / 10,532 = 0.30%). An earlier manual pull recorded 51.2%; that cannot be reproduced from these exports and is likely a different metric. Re-verify in Seller Central before acting on either.
Business Report figures have no date range in the source file and appear to be cumulative/lifetime, not a period. Do not compare them to the Q2 quarterly numbers.
